title: Circuit zero test
statement: For a natural number $n$, an algebraic circuit $C$ with $n$ input variables, and a Boolean list $r$, define the result to be whether the circuit's zero-test core returns true on the prefix of $r$ whose length is the prescribed test length for $n$ and the size of $C$.
caveat: The snippet does not include definitions of the zero-test core, circuit size, or prescribed test length, so their mathematical meanings cannot be made self-contained from the supplied information.
